propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter` imports in _advisory_lock.py and _ref_lock.py that break standalone by-path module loading.
The bridge preview contention interface test fails because _advisory_lock._lock_remote cannot import rebar_reconciler when the module is loaded by file path without package context.

Both _advisory_lock and _ref_lock must use lazy_load with the dotted key 'rebar_reconciler.git_adapter' to restore standalone execution while maintaining module identity across package-context and lazy-load importers.

The repaired lazy-load seams must register the same sys.modules['rebar_reconciler.git_adapter'] object that package-context imports and unchanged callers (_concurrency, reconcile_helpers, apply_outbound, __main__) already use.
